Hand a browser sign-in callback to the running shell

Registered as the handler for the `globalprotectcallback:` URI scheme; not normally run by hand.

Usage: wayle vpn sso-callback <URI>

Arguments:
  <URI>
          The `globalprotectcallback:` URI the browser was sent to

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
